input.command:
$ws='g:\0.DỰ ÁN\Z.WEB-CDN-QUYNHON'
$dataFile = Join-Path $ws '3.SQL\06.10.2026\data - bảng liên quan quyền.sql'
$dbIds = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]
foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($dataFile), "INSERT \[dbo\]\.\[SYS_Permission\] \([^)]*?VALUES \(N'([^']+)'")) { [void]$dbIds.Add($m.Groups[1].Value) }
Write-Output ('DB permission rows: ' + $dbIds.Count)
$dataText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($dataFile)
$grpIds = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]
foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($dataText, "INSERT \[dbo\]\.\[SYS_PermissionGroup\] \([^)]*?VALUES \(N'([^']+)'")) { [void]$grpIds.Add($m.Groups[1].Value) }
Write-Output ('DB permission groups: ' + $grpIds.Count)
Write-Output '--- PermissionGroup list ---'
$grpIds | Sort-Object | Out-String

$ws='g:\0.DỰ ÁN\Z.WEB-CDN-QUYNHON'
$root = Join-Path $ws '1.WEB -CTT'
Write-Output '===== permission gate helpers / base page ====='
Select-String -Path (Join-Path $root '*.cs'),(Join-Path $root 'App_Code\*.cs') -Pattern 'CheckPermission|HasPermission|PermissionGroup|Authorize|IsActived' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 60 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path.Substring($root.Length+1) + ':' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim() } | Out-String -Width 220

Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -Include *.cs -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(obj|bin)\\' } | ForEach-Object { $t=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName); if ($t -match 'public\s+static\s+bool\s+HasPermission') { $_.FullName } } | Out-String

input.command:
$ws='g:\0.DỰ ÁN\Z.WEB-CDN-QUYNHON'
$root = Join-Path $ws '1.WEB -CTT'
$targets = @(
 'Controls\CRM\Portfo\List.ascx.cs','Controls\CRM\Portfo\Edit.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\CRM\SendInfo\List.ascx.cs','Controls\CRM\SendInfo\Edit.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\CRM\Support\List.ascx.cs','Controls\CRM\Support\Edit.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\Report\ChiTietCongNoHocSinh.ascx.cs','Controls\RegisterClassSubject\ClassSubjectLogis.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\Learning\DebtSubjectSummary.ascx.cs','Controls\Learning\SubjectMarkDetail.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\TrainingPlan\TeachingList.ascx.cs','Controls\General\Company\List.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\Poll\Plan\List.ascx.cs','Controls\Poll\Plan\ListEthic.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\RSS\Plan\List.ascx.cs','Controls\RSS\Ret\List.ascx.cs','Controls\RSS\RetBranch\List.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\RSS\RetCate\List.ascx.cs','Controls\RSS\RetGroup\List.ascx.cs','Controls\RSS\RetType\List.ascx.cs',
 'Controls\Ethic\SummaryEthicStudentList.ascx.cs','Dashboards\API\HomeDashboardApi.ashx.cs',
 'Controls\ScheduleChecking\ListSummary.ascx.cs','Controls\ScheduleChecking\SubjectCheckingSummaryByDate.ascx.cs')
foreach ($t in $targets) {
  $p = Join-Path $root $t
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { Write-Output ("{0,-60} FILE NOT FOUND" -f $t); continue }
  $lines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($p)
  $grp = ($lines | Where-Object { $_ -match 'PERMISSION_GROUP\s*=' } | Select-Object -First 1)
  Write-Output ("{0,-58} {1}" -f $t, $(if($grp){$grp.Trim()}else{'(khong co PERMISSION_GROUP)'}))
}

input.command:
$ws='g:\0.DỰ ÁN\Z.WEB-CDN-QUYNHON'
$dataFile = Join-Path $ws '3.SQL\06.10.2026\data - bảng liên quan quyền.sql'
